chats.answer:
The EcoFlow DELTA 3 Plus is the 1 kWh power station that accepts 1,000 W of solar power through two separate inputs.

EcoFlow DELTA 3 Plus

Battery capacity: 1,024 Wh

Maximum solar input: 1,000 W

Solar ports: 2 × XT60, 500 W each

Input voltage: 11–60 V per port

AC output: 1,800 W

Claimed solar recharge time: approximately 70 minutes under ideal conditions

Each solar input has its own MPPT charge controller, allowing two solar panel arrays to charge the battery simultaneously. For example, two 500 W solar arrays, one connected to each input, can provide up to 1,000 W combined, subject to voltage and current limits.

The standard EcoFlow DELTA 3 only supports 500 W of solar input, so you specifically need the DELTA 3 Plus.
